subject: Support coverage modification request — Greenleaf Health
messages:
From: Ruth Sandoval <ruth@greenleafhealth.com>
To: priyom.das@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 3 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: temporary modification to overnight P1/P2 response SLA

Hi Priyom,

Hope you had a good weekend. Quick ask from our ops team: Greenleaf is planning a phased deployment of a new ETL pipeline next month that will increase overnight traffic to the Redwood endpoints by ~2.8x for a 3-week window (2/15–3/8). Our internal on-call headcount is constrained that period due to year-end audits and we need to request a temporary modification to the P1/P2 response SLA for the overnight window (00:00–08:00 PT).

Specifically: could Redwood agree to a P1 response window of 60 minutes and P2 of 4 hours during the dates above for the overnight window, with the understanding that daytime SLOs remain unchanged and we will accept a pre-agreed escalation path to your on-call rotation? We will sign an addendum and accept a possible credit structure if there are missed targets.

I attached our formal waiver request (Greenleaf_SLA_Waiver_Request.pdf) and a short description of the deployment cadence.

Thanks — please let me know next steps and whether you need more detail.

Best,
Ruth
Ruth Sandoval
Head of Platform Reliability
Greenleaf Health

---
Attachment: Greenleaf_SLA_Waiver_Request.pdf (application/pdf, 214 KB)

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 3 Feb 2026 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Request: temporary modification to overnight P1/P2 response SLA

Forwarding Greenleaf's waiver request — they want a 60m P1 and 4h P2 overnight for 2/15–3/8 because of a temporary traffic bump. They offered an addendum + credits.

Immediate questions for ops/CS:
- Is there any precedent for time-windowed SLA exceptions (overnight only) where we tighten daytime SLOs but relax night?
- What are the operational risks if we approve with our current on-call roster?
- Can we propose mitigations (limited on-call stretch, an automated routing policy to fallback model variants to reduce token cost/latency)?

Attaching their PDF. I can own the external comms once we have the scope.

— Priyom
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: Greenleaf_SLA_Waiver_Request.pdf (application/pdf, 214 KB)

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 3 Feb 2026 10:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: temporary modification to overnight P1/P2 response SLA

Thanks for flagging — quick operational read:
- We have supported narrow window exceptions before for a handful of customers, but usually with (a) explicit addendum, (b) a compensated on-call rotation (paid overlay) and (c) tighter daytime readiness.
- Technical mitigations available: shift critical workloads to a higher-priority dedicated pool for those nights (adds cost but reduces capacity-related incidents); enable prefix/KV caching for recurring jobs; and implement a temporary routing policy to automatically fallback to a smaller model variant if latency spikes.

If we're to approve: propose we require Greenleaf to
1) sign a 3-week addendum (doc attached: modified-sla-addendum.docx),
2) accept a 0:00–08:00 PT window where P1=60m/P2=4h,
3) agree to a post-window incident review and accept predefined credits capped at 2% of monthly run rate.

I'll own the runbook updates and can supply an ops rota (oncall-coverage-rotation.csv) showing who covers nights. Sean — do you sign off on the escalation path below?

Operational escalation (proposed):
- P1: immediate page to on-call primary -> 30m escalation to on-call secondary -> 60m exec alert (CS manager + Sr Eng)
- P2: ticket created -> on-call triage within 4h -> product update within 8h

Monica
Sr. Customer Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference

---
Attachments: modified-sla-addendum.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, 52 KB); oncall-coverage-rotation.csv (text/csv, 4 KB)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Feb 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: temporary modification to overnight P1/P2 response SLA

I reviewed the risks — acceptable with conditions. Approve the narrow-window exception if we get:
- Signed addendum with credits cap as Monica described,
- Agreement to allow Redwood to enable temporary model-fallback routing during the window, and
- A single point of contact at Greenleaf for incident coordination (Ruth or Aaron).

I'll mark up the internal escalation playbook and add an explicit exec-notify step (SRE manager + CS Director) at the 60m mark for P1s. We should also update the support portal guidance so on-call knows when to start the extra rotation.

Sean
Head of Customer Success
Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Ruth Sandoval <ruth@greenleafhealth.com>, Aaron Lim <aaron.lim@greenleafhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 4 Feb 2026 09:15:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary modification to overnight P1/P2 response SLA

Hi Ruth / Aaron — thanks for the detailed request and the waiver form. We've reviewed internally and can approve a time-boxed, overnight-only SLA modification for 00:00–08:00 PT during 2026-02-15 to 2026-03-08 with these conditions: 

1) Greenleaf signs the attached 3-week addendum (modified-sla-addendum.docx).
2) Agrees to the credit cap (max 2% monthly run rate) for any missed targets during the window.
3) Agrees to a single incident liaison (please confirm Ruth or Aaron).
4) Redwood may enable temporary model-fallback routing and/or route critical traffic to a dedicated pool to reduce likelihood of escalation.
5) Post-window incident review scheduled within 7 business days of window close.

Operational escalation summary (what will happen if an incident occurs):
- P1: page -> on-call primary (immediate) -> secondary escalate at 30m -> exec notify at 60m (SRE manager + CS Director)
- P2: ticket -> on-call triage within 4h -> product/comp updates within 8h

We will prepare the addendum and send a DocuSign link; please review and confirm the single point of contact so we can finalize. HubSpot ticket: #HSP-4721 will track the addendum and runbook changes.

If you prefer, we can also run a short pre-window test (one-night failover drill) to verify the routing policy — recommend doing that the week before (2/8–2/12).

Thanks — I will circulate the formal addendum after your confirmation.

Best regards,
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
---

Appreciate the quick turnaround.
